name: browser-use
headline: Alby JS SDK - Bitcoin Payment Integration
short_description: JavaScript SDK for integrating Alby OAuth2 Wallet API and Nostr Wallet Connect API. Enables zero-custody bitcoin payments in apps. Connects to lightning network via Nostr Wallet Connect or Alby Wallet API.
author: getAlby

sections.overview:
The Alby JS SDK enables developers to integrate Bitcoin lightning payments directly into web and Node.js applications with minimal code. It supports two integration methods: Nostr Wallet Connect (NWC), an open protocol connecting to any NWC-enabled wallet, and the Alby OAuth API for deeper wallet functionality. Developers can accept payments, request invoices, and send Bitcoin lightning transactions while maintaining zero custody of user funds. The SDK handles credential management, payment routing, and WebLN implementations, making it accessible for building payment-enabled apps, agents, and services.
Accept lightning payments in web applications
Send Bitcoin payments programmatically via lightning network
Request and receive payments with invoice generation
Build payment features into AI agents and LLM-powered apps
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/getAlby/js-sdk`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
